focus: 少說「還在做」，多說「幾點給」
lead: 站會最容易讓人失去信任的，不是進度不夠好，而是用「還在做」、「soon」這種沒有刻度的字眼搪塞——聽的人沒辦法安排自己的下一步，只能被迫繼續等。今天練的是把每一句進度都換成具體鐘點，並且主動設一個「如果趕不上，我幾點前會先講」的提前預警——你不是在給自己加壓力，你是在幫全隊把不確定感降到最低。每個 speaking 段落請先出聲講完再看 model answer。

phrases.en: You'll have it by two — not 'soon', two o'clock.
phrases.ex: Phoebe, you'll have the corrected extrinsics file by two — not 'soon', two o'clock.
phrases.gl: 具體時間點取代「soon」（用鐘點數字讓對方安心排自己的時間，而不是無限期等待）

phrases.en: I'm not done yet, but here's where the number stands right now.
phrases.ex: I'm not done validating the Orin image yet, but here's where the number stands right now: three of five units pass.
phrases.gl: 還沒做完沒關係，先報「現在的數字」而不是等到全部完成才開口（讓對方能提早規劃，不必空等）

phrases.en: Go or no-go by ten, either way.
phrases.ex: Kevin, go or no-go on the five units by ten, either way — even if the answer's not what you want.
phrases.fix: 取代「I'll let you know as soon as possible」
phrases.gl: 不承諾結果，承諾「回覆時間」（讓對方能安排下一步，而不是被你的沉默卡住）

phrases.en: Two vehicles need recalibration — that's a four-hour job, not an all-day one.
phrases.ex: Two vehicles need recalibration after last night's OTA — that's a four-hour job, not an all-day one.
phrases.gl: 把模糊的「需要一些時間」換成具體工時（讓對方能對比自己的行程表）

phrases.en: If I don't hear back by noon, I'm assuming the answer is no and moving on.
phrases.ex: If I don't hear back from Rick by noon on the new labelers' training plan, I'm assuming the answer is no and moving on with the current batch.
phrases.fix: 取代「I'll wait for your reply」
phrases.gl: 幫對方也設一個時限，逼出決定，而不是無限期等待（把等待的責任攤還給對方）

phrases.en: The error rate is eleven percent this week, against a normal four to five.
phrases.ex: The occlusion-tagging error rate is eleven percent this week, against a normal four to five.
phrases.gl: 用「現在 vs 正常」的對比句型講數字，比單講一個數字更有殺傷力（讓聽者立刻知道異常程度）

phrases.en: I'd rather give you a real time now than a fake one I have to walk back later.
phrases.ex: I'd rather give you a real time now than a fake one I have to walk back later — realistically, Thursday, not tomorrow.
phrases.gl: 寧願現在給一個誠實但不好聽的時間，也不要先給一個好聽但守不住的時間（誠實的時間比樂觀的時間更值錢）

phrases.en: That one's still open — I'll close it by end of day.
phrases.ex: The extrinsics recalibration is still open — I'll close it by end of day.
phrases.gl: 主動點名還沒結案的項目，並附上結案時間（不要讓卡點消失在報告的縫隙裡）

phrases.en: Ask me for a number, not a feeling — right now it's three of five.
phrases.ex: Ask me for a number, not a feeling on the Orin validation — right now it's three of five units passing.
phrases.fix: 取代「It's going well, don't worry」
phrases.gl: 邀請對方用數字追問你，而不是用「還好嗎」這種感覺式問句（把報告的顆粒度先訂高）

setup: Setup. Tuesday morning stand-up, four days out from the SRDC v0.0.5 handoff to Simulation, due this Friday. Overnight, all six collection vehicles took an OTA firmware push on the Orin platform, and it reset the sensor extrinsics calibration on two of them. Separately, the outsourced annotation vendor Rick manages onboarded three new labelers this week, and their occlusion-tagging error rate is running at 11%, more than double the usual 4-5%, touching roughly 2,800 of this week's 22,000 frames. Phoebe needs the corrected extrinsics file before she can re-run the fusion pipeline test at 2 p.m. today. Kevin is waiting on a go/no-go on shipping five Orin units to the test site tomorrow morning. David runs the stand-up and cuts in with "so when exactly?" the moment anyone says "soon" or "working on it".

prompts.frame: 承認「soon」沒有幫助，不辯解 → 把工作拆成兩個子任務並各給時間點 → 講清楚一旦超時的下一個回報動作 → 給一個明確的下一次更新時間。
prompts.model: “You're right, 'soon' isn't a number, David — let me give you real ones. Two vehicles need recalibration after last night's OTA — that's a four-hour job, not an all-day one, so the tooling should be done around one. Phoebe needs the corrected extrinsics file for her two o'clock fusion test, and you'll have it by two — not 'soon', two o'clock. If the calibration rig throws an error, I'll know by eleven, and I'll come straight back to you instead of letting you find out at two. Either way, I'll give you a real status by eleven so you can tell Kevin something solid before lunch.”
prompts.q: David: “So when exactly will the two vehicles be back online? 'Soon' doesn't help me tell Kevin anything.”
prompts.say: 出聲講完整段（目標 40 秒）。第一句不准是 “I'm trying my best”，第一句要先講 “You're right, 'soon' isn't a number.”

prompts.frame: 先講現在驗證的真實數字 → 不用「不可能」，講清楚硬上的風險 → 提出折衷方案（先出貨已驗證的部分）→ 給明確的 go/no-go 時間。
prompts.model: “Ask me for a number, not a feeling, Kevin — right now it's three of five units passing validation, not five of five. I could ship all five tonight, but if the other two have the same firmware issue we saw last sprint, your team unpacks broken hardware onsite tomorrow morning, which costs you more than a half-day delay. Here's the trade: I ship the three validated units tonight, and go or no-go on the last two by ten a.m., either way. That gets your team started at seven with hardware that actually works, instead of five units and a coin flip.”
prompts.q: Kevin: “Can we just ship all five Orin units tonight? The test site needs them first thing tomorrow.”
prompts.say: 出聲練習「不要用 no 開頭」。禁用 “let's see”、“maybe”。

prompts.frame: 先講數字對比（11% vs 4-5%）→ 認可對方判斷方向正確 → 給具體替代任務與訓練期限 → 設一個回報時間點確認是否達標。
prompts.model: “That matches what I'm seeing, Rick — eleven percent this week against our normal four to five, and it's concentrated in the new hires' batches. Pulling them off occlusion tagging for now is the right call. Put them on the simpler bounding-box pass instead, and give them until Thursday to get their box-accuracy number under three percent before they touch occlusion again. If I don't hear back from you by noon Thursday with that number, I'm assuming they need another week and I'll tell Phoebe the fusion re-test slips. I'd rather give you a real time now than a fake one I have to walk back later.”
prompts.q: Rick: “The three new labelers are still ramping — should I just pull them off occlusion tagging for now?”
prompts.say: 出聲練習「用數字回應別人的提議，不要只說 yes/no」。禁用 “that's fine”、“whatever works”。

fixes.bad: I will finish it maybe today or tomorrow.
fixes.good: I'll have it by five today. If that changes, I'll tell you by three.
fixes.note: Register（承諾強度）：maybe today or tomorrow 完全沒有承諾力道，聽者無法規劃自己的時間；具體時間加上「若有變動的提前通知點」才是英文職場要的承諾結構。

fixes.bad: The error rate is very high than normal.
fixes.good: The error rate is much higher than normal.
fixes.note: Grammar（比較級）：than 前面要接比較級形容詞（higher），不能是原級（high）加 very；加強語氣要用 much higher、significantly higher，不能用 very higher。

fixes.bad: I am still doing the calibration, not finish yet.
fixes.good: I'm still working on the calibration — not done yet.
fixes.note: Grammar（動詞形態）：not finish 少了 be 動詞和正確分詞，應該是 not finished，或口語直接用 not done；殘缺子句在正式報告裡特別容易被聽出來。

fixes.bad: Please wait me confirm with Rick, then I tell you.
fixes.good: Let me confirm with Rick, then I'll get back to you.
fixes.note: Verb pattern（動詞句型）：wait 不能直接加受詞＋原形動詞（wait me confirm），要嘛 wait for me to confirm，要嘛換句型用 let me confirm；get back to you 也比 I tell you 更自然、更禮貌。

fixes.bad: This issue is because the new labelers don't familiar with our rule.
fixes.good: This is happening because the new labelers aren't familiar with our guidelines yet.
fixes.note: Grammar（be 動詞遺漏＋介系詞搭配）：familiar 是形容詞，前面一定要有 be 動詞（aren't familiar），不能省略；固定搭配是 familiar with，不能寫成 familiar our rule。

challenge:
今天在你的站會或進度回報中做這一件事：把「還在做」換成具體的「幾點給」——

“You'll have ___ by ___ — not 'soon', ___ o'clock. If that changes, I'll tell you by ___.”

錄音作業（60 秒，手機錄）：挑一件你這週對別人說過「soon」或「working on it」的事，重講一次，換成具體時間。

  • 第一句就要出現一個具體的鐘點或日期，不能先解釋原因
  • 中段要有一個「現在 vs 正常」的數字對比句型
  • 結尾要給一個「如果沒達成，我會在幾點前主動告知」的提前預警時間
  • 禁用：soon、working on it、as soon as possible、I'll try、maybe
check: 我今天有沒有講出至少一個具體的鐘點或日期，而不是「soon」或「working on it」？
我報告數字的時候，有沒有講出「現在 vs 正常」的對比，還是只丟一個孤立的數字？
如果我知道自己可能趕不上，我有沒有主動設一個「提前通知」的時間點，而不是等到 deadline 才說？
